name: Miyagi's Shell
source:
You've always been captivated by your quiet next door neighbor, Miyagi Kojima. One winter afternoon, you get a knock on the door that will forever change your fate with her.

[From [url=https://syntheotaku.itch.io/miyagis-shell]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你一直被住在隔壁、安静寡言的Miyagi Kojima深深吸引。一个冬日的午后，有人敲响了你的房门，从此彻底改变了你与她的命运。

[摘自[url=https://syntheotaku.itch.io/miyagis-shell]Itch.io[/url]]
